name: Whisper Transcribe
description: Voice-to-text transcription via a Whisper-compatible API

whisperUrl.label: Whisper API URL
whisperUrl.description: Full URL to the Whisper-compatible transcription endpoint. The harness connects to it, not your browser, so this is shared by every client — set it once and a phone or tablet uses it too.

micDevice.label: Microphone
micDevice.description: Device id, or any part of the device name. Leave blank for the system default. If nothing matches, the composer chip and its tooltip say which mic is actually live.

model.label: Model
model.description: Model name to request, for endpoints that need one (e.g. whisper-1). Leave blank for the server's default.

language.label: Language
language.description: ISO-639-1 hint (e.g. en). Leave blank to auto-detect.

whisperSecretName.label: API key secret name
whisperSecretName.description: Name of a Modus secret holding the API key. The harness resolves it and sends it upstream — the key itself never reaches the browser. Only used for https or local endpoints. Shared by every client.
